'''Visgura thread''' was a type of sewing material often incorporated into the clothing of [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] elite. It was derived from the egg cases of a long-extinct [[Species/Legends|species]] of indigenous spider. [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] wore a costume that used visgura thread.
